app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.26 COMMON GX
app.long_description: Common experimental GS-to-GX renderer: four texture functions, fog, untextured triangles, supported varying alpha, all clamp modes and small texture padding. Shared by games based on GS state; no per-title renderer. Unsupported masks, feedback, mipmaps and complex blends retain software/hybrid paths. Full output size. Chain/PSM factory OFF; saved settings unchanged. No hardware-confirmed gameplay, tile correction or FPS gain. Compare with the Beta25Control DOL. Bring your own legal BIOS/disc.
